name: Offline page
summary: What a person sees with no connection: that they are offline, what still works on this device, and what waits until they're back.
use: when the app has no network connection and the next screen needs one
a11y: The list of what still works is a real list; a polite status line reports each reconnect check and the last sync time.

use_when: the browser or device reports no connection
requests time out repeatedly and cached data exists
avoid_when: the server is up but failing: use page-error
only one feature needs the network: show a warning banner in that place instead (page-banners)

parts.name: title
parts.what: the heading: what happened, in plain words, as in “You're offline”

parts.name: message
parts.what: one or two sentences: what it means and what to do next, as in “Check your Wi-Fi or mobile data. We'll reconnect”

parts.name: works.text
parts.what: the text, as in “Read the 24 notes you opened this week”

parts.name: waits.text
parts.what: the text, as in “Sharing, comments and new files from your team”

parts.name: synced
parts.what: when the device last synced, as in “Last synced today at 10:42 AM”

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: Try again now shows a spinner while it checks the connection.

error.how: The part is itself an error or system state, written in plain words with a next step.

disabled.how: The button is aria-disabled while it checks.

overflow.how: Actions stack full width under 30rem; the panel caps its width.

long_text.how: Titles balance and body text wraps at word boundaries inside a capped measure.

keyboard: Tab moves through the links and buttons in reading order
Enter follows a link; Enter or Space presses a button
